sections.Profile:
The "Snooks" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on June 14, 1951, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Gordon Horlick, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Flowers, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Bugs, Garden
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Gordon Horlick
- Art: George Molentin
